mcqs.q: If you divide both sides of an inequality by -2, what happens to the inequality sign?
options: (-3)^2 equals -6 because the negative makes you subtract.
The inequality sign reverses (e.g. > becomes <).

options: x^0 equals x because the zero has no effect.
1 — any non-zero number to the power of zero equals 1.
x^0 equals 0 because raising something to the zero gives nothing.
